notes: screens_min 3 counts product pictures of any shape (screens, phones or upright photos): one a step is what the held walk shows; with fewer the walk is words only and the page is not one to offer.
features: at least 3 for the tiles; 4 or more further ones (7 in all) before the sideways card row is held as on the reference.
figures: at least 1 whose value is a single number, for the turned band; quotes would fill its running rows but neither test client has any, so that path is written and not exercised.

media.made.land is needed for the opening and closing backdrops, the walk's field, the tile panes and the cards; without it every slot falls to the plain ground and the page loses the picture share the reference has — not measured on a client without made pictures.
plans and faq are optional: each is shown when present (plans as tiles before the questions, questions as disclosure rows before the close) and left out whole when absent.
drops (as written): media.photos beyond the step pictures and one upright picture for the tall tile
drops (as written): media.phones beyond the step pictures and one for the opening
